useWhen: Documenting business processes for system design

workflow.description: Identify 3-5 core processes, gather stakeholder input, define start/end conditions
Map current steps, actors, inputs, outputs, decisions, and handoffs
Identify bottlenecks, redundancies, handoffs, exceptions, and manual steps
Create improved future-state processes using eliminate/simplify/automate/reorder
Evaluate what's suitable for automation based on repetition, rules, and error rate
Apply quick wins framework: high impact + low effort first

examples.input: Map the customer onboarding process for a B2B SaaS. Currently takes 2 weeks and involves 5 different people.
examples.context: B2B SaaS onboarding, inefficient manual process
examples.output:
**AS-IS PROCESS (Current)**

```
[Customer signs up]
       ↓
[Sales sends welcome email] ── 1 day wait
       ↓
[CS creates account in system] ── Manual data entry
       ↓
[Account team configures settings] ── 2-3 days
       ↓
[CS schedules onboarding call] ── Email back-and-forth
       ↓
[Onboarding call with customer] ── 1 hour
       ↓
[CS creates training materials] ── Custom each time
       ↓
[Account handed to support] ── No clear handoff
```

**ANALYSIS**

| Issue | Location | Impact |
|-------|----------|--------|
| 5 day wait before onboarding starts | Start | Delays value realization |
| Manual data entry | Account creation | 30 min, errors possible |
| Email back-and-forth | Scheduling | 2-3 days, frustrated customers |
| Custom training each time | Materials | 2 hours per customer |
| No clear handoff | End | Inconsistent experience |

**TO-BE PROCESS (Improved)**

```
[Customer signs up]
       ↓
[System auto-creates account + sends welcome] ── Instant
       ↓
[Self-service onboarding portal] ── Customer-led
       ↓
[Auto-schedule onboarding call] ── Calendar integration
       ↓
[Onboarding call] ── Standard agenda
       ↓
[Auto-generate training from template]
       ↓
[Auto-handoff to support + context]
```

**AUTOMATION OPPORTUNITIES**

| Process Step | Automate? | Rationale |
|--------------|-----------|----------|
| Account creation | YES | Rule-based, frequent, error-prone |
| Welcome email | YES | Same content, instant |
| Scheduling | YES | Calendar API integration |
| Training materials | YES | Template-based |
| Handoff | YES | Clear rules |

**QUICK WINS**

| Improvement | Effort | Impact |
|-------------|--------|--------|
| Auto welcome email | 1 day | -5 days to start |
| Calendar scheduling link | 2 days | -2 days wait |
| Training template | 3 days | -2 hours per customer |

**PRIORITY**
1. Calendar scheduling (2 days, high impact)
2. Auto welcome email (1 day, high impact)
3. Training templates (3 days, medium impact)

examples.input: Our bug report process involves multiple teams and has quality issues. Map it and find improvements.
examples.output:
**AS-IS PROCESS**

```
[Customer reports bug via email]
       ↓
[Support logs in Jira] ── Duplicate reports, unclear priority
       ↓
[Support assigns to dev] ── Who owns which?
       ↓
[Dev investigates] ── Often not reproducible
       ↓
[Dev fixes or rejects] ── No clear criteria
       ↓
[QA verifies fix] ── Long wait for QA
       ↓
[Support closes ticket] ── Customer not notified
```

**ANALYSIS**

| Issue | Frequency | Impact |
|-------|-----------|--------|
| Duplicate reports | 30% of tickets | Wasted time |
| Unclear priority | Most tickets | Urgent bugs wait |
| Not reproducible | 40% of bugs | Wasted dev time |
| No rejection criteria | Variable | Bugs linger |
| Customer not notified | All | Poor experience |

**TO-BE PROCESS**

```
[Customer reports via portal with template]
       ↓
[System auto-tags duplicates] ── Link to existing
       ↓
[Auto-prioritize based on rules] ── Impact + frequency
       ↓
[Dev picks from queue] ── Self-service
       ↓
[Dev adds reproduction steps or rejects] ── Clear criteria
       ↓
[QA tests if needed] ── Not all need QA
       ↓
[Auto-notify customer on close]
```

**AUTOMATION ASSESSMENT**

| Opportunity | Good for Auto? | Notes |
|-------------|----------------|-------|
| Duplicate detection | YES | Keyword matching |
| Auto-prioritization | YES | Rule-based |
| Self-service queue | YES | Dev team autonomy |
| Customer notification | YES | Template-based |

**QUICK WINS**

| Improvement | Effort | Impact |
|-------------|--------|--------|
| Bug report template | 1 day | Better info, 40% fewer "can't reproduce" |
| Customer notification | 1 day | Better experience |
| Priority rules | 2 days | Faster turnaround |

**PRIORITY**
1. Bug template (quick, high impact)
2. Auto-notification (quick, high impact)
3. Priority rules (medium, high impact)
